digest.component_or_area: tickets store provisioning and CI checkout workflow
propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall, while partial clone with --filter=blob:none costs 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x reduction), and CI checkout step takes 237s versus 2s for manual worktree mount
rebar init silently bootstraps a fresh empty orphan store when fetch times out, diverging from origin/tickets and causing all reads to return empty and writes to land on an unreachable branch
blob:none partial clone is safe for rebar's access patterns including verify-identity and commit-ancestry scoping because it preserves the complete commit graph while only omitting blob objects
fail-open fallthrough to worktree add --orphan must be replaced with fail-closed error exit to prevent diverged empty stores
derive_caused_by must return None on any per-path blame failure rather than tallying partial paths, preventing incorrect caused_by links
gerrit-verify.yaml verify-identity job performs a full-history fetch that is 92% of total job time and should inherit the partial clone filter
